tool.name: IMAGINE-X subhkl Diffraction Parallax & Lattice Ladder
tool.description: Interactive Laue zone curves, detector pixel intensity heatmaps, and 2-tier NDIP + Solve Lattice Ladder
tool.command: mkdir -p out && ln -sf "$indexed_h5" input_peaks.h5 && #set $img_opt = "" #if $images_h5: ln -sf "$images_h5" input_images.h5 && #set $img_opt = " --images input_images.h5 " #end if #set $proj_opt = "" #if str($projection) != "auto": #set $proj_opt = " --projection " + str($projection) + " " #end if python -m subhkl.io.parser rainbow-visualize input_peaks.h5 $img_opt $proj_opt --instrument "$instrument" --max-zone-index "$max_zone_index" --tolerance-deg "$tolerance_deg" -o out/rainbow_zones.html

param.name: indexed_h5
param.label: Solved / Indexed / Integrated SubHKL HDF5 (solve.h5, indexer.h5, integrator.h5)

param.name: images_h5
param.label: Detector Image HDF5 (scan.h5 / merged.h5)
param.help: Optional raw/reduced detector bank image stack for log-scaled pixel intensity grounding.

tool.help:
**IMAGINE-X subhkl Diffraction Parallax & Lattice Ladder**
Generates a self-contained HTML5/Canvas interactive diagnostic from a `subhkl` HDF5 file (`solve.h5`, `indexer.h5`, or `integrator.h5`):
- **Coarse NDIP Workflow Pipeline Bar**: Tracks `1. REDUCE & MERGE` -> `2. SOLVE (LATTICE LADDER)` -> `3. PREDICT & INTEGRATE` -> `4. MERGE & MTZ`. - **Step 1–5 Solve Lattice Ladder**: Animates the 5 internal solve stages (`1. Binned Count Excess` -> `2. 13→145 Zone Ladder` -> `3. 60-Zone Global` -> `4. 120→400 Zone + Cell` -> `5. Converged Solve UB`). - **2-Layer Depth Parallax**: Move the mouse over the detector view to shift predicted Bragg reflection rings aside and inspect raw detector spot morphology directly underneath.
